title: Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master Missing Authentication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of Apache ActiveMQ. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of an administrator.
